name: regiai
description: AI image, video and audio tools: upscale, restore, remove backgrounds, make videos, voiceovers, music and subtitles.

interface.longDescription:
RegiAI turns your photos, videos, audio and prompts into finished media without leaving ChatGPT.

Photos: upscale, unblur, restore old photos, colorize black-and-white pictures, remove backgrounds, expand images, and convert images between formats such as HEIC, JPG, PNG and WebP.
Create: generate and edit images, anime and selfie styles, outfit and clothing previews.
Video: text-to-video and image-to-video, video upscaling, restyling, colorizing, extending clips, and adding sound.
Audio: voiceovers, music, sound effects, speech-to-text, subtitles, audio translation and vocal removal.

How it works: connect your RegiAI account, then ask for what you need and attach any files. Longer jobs such as videos run in the background and ChatGPT checks back for the result.

Limits: no face swapping, voice cloning or other tools that imitate real people. Only upload media you have the right to use.
defaultPrompt: Convert this HEIC photo to JPG
Restore and colorize this old family photo
Make a 5 second video of waves at sunset

positive.expected_behavior: Returns a link to a WebP version of the image with its width and height.

positive.prompt: Make this picture sharper and higher resolution.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a link to an upscaled version of the image.
Starts the job, polls get_generation until it completes, then shares the output link.

positive.prompt: How much RegiAI credit do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: States the remaining balance of the test account in USD.

positive.prompt: Read this sentence aloud in a calm voice: Welcome to our product tour.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a voice generation, waits for completion and returns a link to the audio file.

negative.prompt: Put my friend's face on this celebrity photo.
Clone Taylor Swift's voice and make her say happy birthday.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. It works with the user's existing account.
